name: jailbreak-benchmark-dataset-benign-advbench
description: A dataset of benign and adversarial (jailbreak) prompts intended to evaluate model robustness to prompt-injection and jailbreak attempts. It measures whether models follow harmful or disallowed instructions when presented with adversarially crafted inputs. Useful for safety evaluation and hardening of instruction-following models.
reputation: A niche safety benchmark hosted on Hugging Face, used by practitioners researching model jailbreaks and prompt-injection vulnerabilities; modest community adoption.
